caseNameFull: Milner Hotels, Inc. v. Porter, Price Administrator and 101 East First Street Incorporated v. Porter, Price Administrator
attorneys: R. Lee Blackwell and Wrn. Marshall Bullitt for petitioners. Solicitor General McGrath and David London for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.

Reported below: 154 F. 2d 1020.
